title: Vittlery
subtitle: Meal planning, recipes, cooking tools, and smart shopping lists
description: Vittlery is a meal planning, recipe, cooking, and shopping web application designed to take users from deciding what to eat through planning, shopping, and cooking.

The application combines automated weekly and monthly meal planning, recipe management, interactive cooking tools, serving-size scaling, food preferences, leftovers, meal history, and automatically generated shopping lists in one connected platform.

Meal planning can account for household size, selected meal types, allergies, dietary restrictions, blocked foods and recipes, likes and dislikes, budget preferences, recurring meals, cooking preferences, and meal history.

Vittlery also supports public recipe discovery, ratings and reviews, household sharing, collaborative shopping lists, approximate ingredient and recipe cost estimates, nutrition information, metric and imperial measurements, printing, dark mode, and responsive desktop and mobile use.
features: Interactive cooking mode and cooking timers
Automatic recipe scaling and unit conversion
Meal preferences, recurring meals, and leftovers
Public recipe ratings, reviews, and discovery
